question: Should ClawHub make case-colliding SKILL.md, skills.md, and PROTOCOL.md files a hard publish/import rejection now, and where should that package rule be documented?
rationale: The code shape is coherent, but the rule changes an accepted package contract and includes PROTOCOL.md scope that current docs/specs do not define.

options.title: Document And Prove Strict Rejection
options.body: Record the collision policy in the skill format/GitHub import spec and require redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Accept The Compatibility Break
options.body: Merge the stricter gate as-is if maintainers are comfortable owning support guidance for existing colliding packages.

options.title: Pause For Package Policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether PROTOCOL.md belongs in the ClawHub package contract.

recommendation.title: Document And Prove Strict Rejection
recommendation.body: Record the collision policy in the skill format/GitHub import spec and require redacted live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current release-boundary package contract and is requested for live PR review.
